an8.9:1.2: ‘balavā' ti bhikkhave Nandaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya,
an8.9:1.3: ‘pāsādiko' ti bhikkhave Nandaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya,
an8.9:1.4: ‘tibbarāgo' ti bhikkhave Nandaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
an8.9:1.5: Kim aññatra bhikkhave Nando indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū jāgariyaṃ anuyutto satisampajaññena samannāgato, yena Nando sakkoti paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ? 2.
an8.9:1.6: Tatr' idaṃ bhikkhave Nandassa indriyesu guttadvāratāya hoti.
an8.9:1.7: Sace bhikkhave Nandassa puratthimā disā āloketabbā hoti, sabbañ cetaso samannāharitvā Nando puratthimaṃ disaṃ āloketi
an8.9:1.8: ‘evaṃ me puratthimaṃ disaṃ ālokayato nābhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssavissantī' ti.
an8.9:2.1: Sace bhikkhave Nandassa pacchimā disā āloketabbā hoti . . .
an8.9:2.6: anudisā anuviloketabbā hoti, sabbañ cetaso samannāharitvā Nando anudisaṃ anuviloketi
an8.9:2.7: ‘evaṃ me anudisaṃ anuvilokayato nābhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssavissantī' ti.
an8.9:2.9: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave Nandassa indriyesu guttadvāratāya hoti. 3.
an8.9:3.1: Tatr' idaṃ bhikkhave Nandassa bhojane mattaññutāya hoti.
an8.9:3.2: Idha bhikkhave Nando paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti
an8.9:3.3: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva-d-eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya ‘iti purāṇañ ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañ ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā' ti.
an8.9:3.4: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave Nandassa bhojane mattaññutāya hoti. 4.
an8.9:4.1: Tatr' idaṃ bhikkhave Nandassa jāgariyānuyogasmiṃ hoti.
an8.9:4.2: Idha bhikkhave Nando divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇiyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti,
an8.9:4.3: rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇiyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti,
an8.9:4.4: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā,
an8.9:4.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇiyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
an8.9:4.6: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave Nandassa jāgariyānuyogasmiṃ hoti. 5.
an8.9:5.1: Tatr' idaṃ bhikkhave Nandassa satisampajaññasmiṃ hoti.
an8.9:5.2: Idha bhikkhave Nandassa viditā vedanā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti;
an8.9:5.4: viditā vitakkā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
an8.9:5.5: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave Nandassa satisampajaññasmiṃ hoti.
an8.9:6.1: Kim aññatra bhikkhave Nando indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū jāgariyam anuyutto satisampajaññena samannāgato, yena Nando sakkoti paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritun ti?
